calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Ffern
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around how GrowthBook’s architecture and SDK could integrate with Fern's existing systems to manage feature flags and A/B testing. Key topics included local snapshot evaluation for flicker reduction, flexible user assignment using deterministic hashing, and event tracking compatibility with Snowflake. GrowthBook's server-side SDK and event forwarder were highlighted for simplifying schema mapping. The analysis capabilities of GrowthBook, including real-time querying of metrics and guardrail features for automated experiment management, were discussed to ensure safer experimentation. Pricing concerns were addressed with GrowthBook's enterprise tier being deemed prohibitive for Fern, leading to a proposed trial to assess fit before further discussions. Support logistics for a one-week trial, including Slack access to engineers, were also outlined.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, feature flagging, Snowflake integration, experiment analytics, growthbook SDK, pricing discussion
calls.action_items:
**James Shannon**
Set up a Slack channel connecting Fern and GrowthBook engineers for support and questions during the trial period (38:54)
Provide trial license access for Fern to test GrowthBook platform, ideally for one week (38:42)
Follow up with Fern approximately one week after trial start to review experience and discuss pricing and commercial terms (40:34)

**Fern Team (Niall, Jack, Andrew)**
Test GrowthBook platform by running AA experiments and evaluate integration and feature fit with Fern’s existing systems (38:42)
